tools.name: agent_get_state
tools.title: Get MCMCP State
tools.description: Returns the latest immutable, policy-filtered client state and the latest observation-frame summary. Pass no arguments for state only. To search client-known recipe displays, use {"query":{"kind":"result_item","item":"minecraft:stick"},"max_results":16} or {"query":{"kind":"result_tag","tag":"minecraft:planks"},"max_results":16}; the bounded result appears in recipe_query. inventory keeps item-ID totals; standard_potions separately validates component-exact unmodified Vanilla singleton potion stacks and groups them by item+potion across inventory slots, so brewing inputs and outputs are distinguishable without exposing custom components or impossible overstacks. merchant_offers is present only while the exact current merchant screen has a fresh same-session/container/open-revision server packet; it exposes typed item/count facts and registered stored-enchantment IDs+levels, never raw slots, components, NBT, lore, or display text. Calling this announces observation.latest_frame_id with a 60-second idle lifetime; at most 16 announced handles are retained, so an older handle may be evicted sooner. Recipe data comes only from displays synchronized into the current client recipe book. It never scans hidden world data.

ready_expires_at.description: Schema v1 compatibility field; always null because READY does not expire

standard_potions.description: Own-inventory projection only. Validates component-exact unmodified Vanilla singleton potion stacks, then groups them by item+potion across slots; impossible overstacks, custom color/effects/name/lore, or any other nonstandard component are omitted rather than exposed.

merchant_offers.description: Optional exact-current-screen projection. Omitted unless the visible MerchantScreen, player menu, world session, container ID, and open-packet revision all match the latest inbound merchant-offers packet.

latest_frame_id.description: Handle announced by agent_get_state; retained for up to 60 idle seconds subject to the 16-handle cap

visible_surface.description: Number of deliverable unique visible block positions after representative-face compaction

tools.name: agent_get_observation
tools.title: Get MCMCP Observation
tools.description: Returns a stable, paged projection of one policy-filtered omnidirectional frame; it accepts no arbitrary center or radius. Ask for one purpose at a time: crop/chest/gate=visible_surface, drops=visible_entity, route=traversability. Use optional filter to return only relevant block_ids, entity_types, displayed_items, crop_mature, or one inclusive position_bounds; filters applicable to a record kind are ANDed and only remove already-policy-visible records, so they cannot weaken safety evidence or expose hidden state. position_bounds anchors visible_surface at position, visible_entity/hazard/unknown_boundary/sound_clue at floor(position), and traversability at navigation_target. For harvest use {block_ids:["minecraft:wheat"],crop_mature:true}; for drops use {entity_types:["minecraft:item"],displayed_items:["minecraft:wheat","minecraft:wheat_seeds"]}. visible_surface is one representative face per block position and is ordered mature crop, immature crop, then other surfaces, near-first. Every visible_surface includes required nullable state and placement_item fields. state is complete only for the closed construction copy/support and furnace-family target allowlist and is null for all other blocks so non-rendered properties never cross the visual boundary. A non-null placement_item always has a non-null state and marks an apply_known_block_plan copy source. Use the smallest useful limit. If next_cursor is non-null, either continue that exact frame/kinds/filter query immediately or allow its bounded 60-second lease to expire; abandoning two paged queries makes a third root query SERVER_BUSY. Only static visible_surface records actually returned may remain planner-usable for at most 60 seconds; dynamic records are never extended. On FRAME_EXPIRED, call agent_get_state and retry with observation.latest_frame_id.

positionBounds.description: One inclusive integer block-coordinate box in one dimension. This is a delivery-only filter over the selected frame, not an observation center or radius.

completeBlockState.description: Complete registered runtime BlockState. properties contains every property defined by block; property-free blocks use an empty object.

visibleSurface.description: One deterministic representative visible face for this block position; UP is preferred over horizontal faces, which are preferred over DOWN. state is the complete runtime BlockState only for the closed construction copy/support and furnace-family target allowlist (copyable blocks plus minecraft:dirt, minecraft:grass_block, minecraft:obsidian, minecraft:furnace, minecraft:blast_furnace, and minecraft:smoker), and null otherwise so hidden properties are not disclosed. placement_item is the ordinary inventory item that may reproduce a non-null state through the closed placement adapter, or null when this surface is not eligible for safe copy placement.

displayed_item.description: Present only for a visible minecraft:item entity; registry identity of its rendered non-empty ItemStack. Stack count, components, UUID, owner, pickup delay, and age are intentionally omitted.

navigation_target.description: Exact integer player feet-space cell accepted by navigate_to_known.target; copy without rounding from/to

tools.name: agent_start_action
tools.title: Start MCMCP Action
tools.description: Runs one validated Action DSL v1 program while in-game MCP operation is enabled. Choose Action boundaries from current evidence: combine nodes only when every later node is admissible now or has an explicitly supported dependency proof. Batch 2..8 targets within one crop stage; when a mutation creates new drops or newly exposed surfaces, finish, reobserve, then start the next Action. apply_known_block_plan is the bounded exception for explicitly declared earlier-entry placement dependencies. Put wait_until immediately after its plant node when growth must be awaited. Copy traversability.navigation_target verbatim into navigate_to_known.target; never derive, floor, round, or copy continuous traversability.from/to coordinates. When you have a visible block but no safe feet coordinate, copy visible_surface.position and block verbatim into approach_known_surface; the runtime selects a known interaction-range navigation cell, then finish the Action and reobserve before mutation. collect_visible_item and collect_visible_item_batch targets are the only continuous positions: copy visible_entity.position and displayed_item without rounding. Use collect_visible_item_batch for 2..8 current drops instead of one Action per item. For building copy, use only visible_surface records whose placement_item is non-null: copy state verbatim into source_state and placement_item into item. Never convert state properties yourself. Construction requires every support to be within 40 total yaw+pitch degrees of the admitted heading; when it is not, put face_known_position for a visible support immediately before the plan or split the plan. For crafting, query agent_get_state recipes first, copy one current recipe_ref and fingerprint into craft_known_recipe.recipe_ref and recipe_fingerprint, and use one current visible minecraft:crafting_table. For smelting, copy one current furnace-family recipe_ref and fingerprint, the visible station state, and one default-component fuel into smelt_known_recipe; this single-smelt node must be the final top-level node outside if/repeat. For brewing, use own-inventory standard_potions evidence and one current visible minecraft:brewing_stand; brew_known_potion_batch accepts one catalog-fixed standard Vanilla one-step recipe for 1..3 bottles and must be the final top-level node outside if/repeat. For Redstone, apply_known_redstone_spec is only the stationary two-block lever-to-lamp identity slice; use a current visible inert UP support under the lamp, a current visible minecraft:glass UP support under the lever, and four other LIVE-visible air face-neighbors around the lever; do not infer wire or arbitrary logic. The envelope is {schema_version:1,program:{dsl_version:1,name?:string,capabilities:string[],body:node[]},budget:{max_duration_ms,max_ticks,max_distance_blocks,max_camera_degrees,max_interactions,max_blocks_broken,max_blocks_placed}}. Every node needs a unique id matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ and one exact op. Frequent exact signatures are navigate_to_known:{id,op,target,tolerance}; approach_known_surface:{id,op,target,expected_block}; open_known_passage/inspect_known_container:{id,op,target,expected_block}; take_known_container_stack:{id,op,target,expected_block,item,stack_policy,minimum_inventory_count}; craft_known_recipe:{id,op,recipe_ref,recipe_fingerprint,goal:{item,stack_policy,minimum_inventory_count},station:{kind,target,expected_state},max_crafts}; smelt_known_recipe:{id,op,recipe_ref,recipe_fingerprint,goal:{item,stack_policy,minimum_inventory_count},station:{kind,target,expected_state},fuel:{item,stack_policy},max_smelts}; brew_known_potion_batch:{id,op,target,expected_block,input:{item,potion,count},ingredient_item,fuel_item,expected_output:{item,potion,count}}; till_known_batch:{id,op,targets:[position],expected_block,hoe_item}; plant_known_wheat_batch:{id,op,targets:[{target,support}],seed_item}; harvest_known_wheat_batch:{id,op,targets:[position]}; apply_known_block_plan:{id,op,anchor,transform:{rotation,mirror},entries:[{id,offset,source_state,item,support:{position,face,expected_state,dependency_entry_id}}]}; apply_known_redstone_spec:{id,op,anchor,rotation,components:[{id,role,block}],truth_table:[{inputs:{input},outputs:{output}}],footprint:{x,y,z},timing:{settle_ticks}}; collect_visible_item_batch:{id,op,targets:[{displayed_item,target}]}. Both support.expected_state and support.dependency_entry_id are required nullable fields and exactly one must be non-null. Exact ops are navigate_to_known, approach_known_surface, face_known_position, break_known_face, till_known_block, till_known_batch, plant_known_wheat, plant_known_wheat_batch, harvest_known_wheat, harvest_known_wheat_batch, apply_known_block_plan, apply_known_redstone_spec, open_known_fence_gate, open_known_passage, inspect_known_container, take_known_container_stack, craft_known_recipe, smelt_known_recipe, brew_known_potion_batch, collect_visible_item, collect_visible_item_batch, wait_ticks, wait_until, if, and repeat; use the exact inputSchema fields and no aliases. Required capabilities are navigate/approach/collect=movement; face=camera; break/harvest=camera+block_break; till/open=camera+block_interact; plant/apply_known_block_plan=camera+block_place; apply_known_redstone_spec=camera+block_interact+block_place; inspect/take/craft/smelt/brew=camera+inventory_transfer. For each inspect/take/craft reserve at least 30000 ms, 600 ticks, 360 camera degrees, and its schema-stated interactions; craft reserves exactly 1+4*max_crafts interactions. For smelt reserve 120000 ms, 2400 ticks, up to 540 camera degrees for aim plus view restoration, and 6 interactions. For brew reserve at least 70000 ms, 1400 ticks, up to 540 camera degrees for aim plus view restoration, and 16 interactions; distance, breaks, and placements are zero. For each apply_known_block_plan entry reserve 15000 ms, 300 ticks, 80 camera degrees, and one placement; an 8-entry plan therefore needs 120000 ms, 2400 ticks, 640 camera degrees, and 8 placements with zero movement, interactions, and breaks. For apply_known_redstone_spec reserve (400 + 3*settle_ticks) ticks, 50 times that many milliseconds, 720 camera degrees, 2 interactions, and 2 placements; distance and breaks are zero. For another 8-target mutation batch, reserve 120000 ms, 2400 ticks, up to the 720 camera-degree policy maximum, and 8 interactions/breaks/placements as applicable. Targets always execute in submitted order; if that order costs more than 720 camera degrees, split it into smaller batches instead of reordering at runtime. take stack_policy is exactly default_components_only or item_id_any_components; craft/smelt goal.stack_policy and smelt fuel.stack_policy are exactly default_components_only. Use observed coordinates and policy maxima when unsure of an adequate budget. PROGRAM_BUDGET_UNPROVABLE reports all insufficient budget component names without echoing submitted values.

completeBlockState.description: Complete registered runtime BlockState copied without omission from visible_surface.state. Unknown, missing, duplicate, or invalid properties fail before input.

navigateNode.description: Copy traversability.navigation_target verbatim into target. Never derive, floor, round, or copy the continuous traversability.from/to coordinates.

approachKnownSurfaceNode.description: Copy one current visible_surface.position and block verbatim. The runtime chooses the shortest reachable policy-known feet cell whose geometric eye-to-block distance is within a conservative interaction envelope; it never derives or exposes hidden terrain. This node only approaches. End the Action, request a fresh observation from the new eye position, and only then submit a block interaction or mutation.

tillBatchNode.description: Till 1..8 distinct currently visible blocks in the submitted target order. Every target uses the same expected_block and hoe_item. Each target reserves and performs at most 40 active ticks of fresh reproof immediately before use; current plus the complete unstarted suffix must still fit before dispatch. The batch never reorders or skips targets and fails without continuing if any target cannot be exactly aimed, reproved, or server-confirmed; admission TARGET_UNKNOWN identifies the first failing entry as target[index]. Passive, input-neutral 1/16-block farmland settling is audited separately from input distance.

targets.description: Admission TARGET_UNKNOWN identifies the first failing entry as target[index]

plantWheatBatchNode.description: Plant 1..8 distinct wheat plots in the submitted target order. Each entry declares the crop target and its farmland support. Every support reserves and performs at most 40 active ticks of fresh reproof; current plus the complete unstarted suffix must fit before dispatch. The batch never reorders or skips targets and fails without continuing if any target cannot be exactly aimed, reproved, or completed.

targets.description: Admission TARGET_UNKNOWN identifies the first failing entry as target[index]

harvestWheatBatchNode.description: Harvest 1..8 distinct currently mature wheat blocks in the submitted target order. Every target reserves and performs at most 40 active ticks of fresh reproof; current plus the complete unstarted suffix must fit before dispatch. The batch never reorders or skips targets and fails without continuing if any target cannot be exactly aimed, reproved, or completed.

targets.description: Admission TARGET_UNKNOWN identifies the first failing entry as target[index]

blockPlanSupport.description: The target must be exactly one block beyond position in face direction. Select exactly one witness: copy a current visible_surface.state into expected_state and set dependency_entry_id to null, or set expected_state to null and name an earlier entry whose transformed target exactly equals position. Existing supports are accepted only when placement_item is non-null or block is minecraft:dirt, minecraft:grass_block, or minecraft:obsidian.

source_state.description: Copy one eligible source visible_surface.state verbatim. The runtime transforms this complete state with Minecraft mirror/rotation rules; do not rewrite facing, axis, rotation, shape, or other properties.

item.description: Copy the same source visible_surface.placement_item; null sources are not eligible entries.

applyKnownBlockPlanNode.description: Stationary place-only Phase 3 vertical slice for 1..8 ordered entries. Each transformed target is anchor plus offset after mirror (none/x/z) then clockwise Y rotation (0/90/180/270); transformed targets and entry ids must be unique. source_state and item come verbatim from one eligible visible_surface. The runtime applies Minecraft's BlockState mirror/rotation rules, so the policy never converts directional properties. Each entry uses either a current complete support-state witness or an explicit earlier-entry dependency. Every support aim must be within 40 total yaw+pitch degrees of the admitted heading; use a preceding face_known_position or a smaller plan when necessary. An entry already at its exact transformed expected-after state is adopted without input or placement budget, but success still requires a later fresh exact verification of every entry. No movement, breaking, replacement, hidden scan, NBT, fluid, gravity block, container, portal, or command block is admitted. Execution is fail-fast, never reorders entries, and requires authoritative placement postconditions. Reserve 15000 ms, 300 ticks, 80 camera degrees, and one max_blocks_placed per entry; distance, interactions, and breaks are zero.

transform.description: Mirror is applied first (x=FRONT_BACK/east-west reversal; z=LEFT_RIGHT/north-south reversal), then clockwise Y rotation.

applyKnownRedstoneSpecNode.description: Closed stationary Phase 5 identity slice only. anchor is the redstone lamp target; rotation places the lever one block away at +X/+Z/-X/-Z for 0/90/180/270. components must contain exactly input lever and output redstone lamp, truth_table must contain exactly false-to-false and true-to-true, footprint is exactly 2x1x1, and settle_ticks is 1..20. The lamp requires a current policy-visible inert UP support; the lever requires a current policy-visible minecraft:glass UP support. The four remaining face-neighbors around the lever must each be LIVE-current visible air before either placement and before each toggle. Runtime places lamp then lever and confirms lamp/lever OFF, ON, and OFF as same-client-tick live visual pairs. It never moves, breaks, synthesizes arbitrary circuits, or admits wire, NOT, or repeater components. Reserve (400 + 3*settle_ticks) ticks, 50 times that many milliseconds, 720 camera degrees, 2 interactions, and 2 placements; distance and breaks are zero.

openPassageNode.description: Open one currently visible allowlisted wooden door, trapdoor, or fence gate. A door succeeds only after both halves are authoritatively open.

inspectContainerNode.description: Open one visible in-reach single chest/barrel and return up to 27 server-synchronized item counts in NODE_EVIDENCE. Reserve at least 600 ticks, 30000 ms, 360 camera degrees, and 1 interaction; this includes Action dispatch/JIT headroom around the bounded 400-tick container attempt.

takeContainerStackNode.description: Move at most one whole matching stack from one visible in-reach single chest/barrel, then close/reopen it for full server readback. Reserve at least 600 ticks, 30000 ms, 360 camera degrees, and 3 interactions; this includes Action dispatch/JIT headroom around the bounded 400-tick container attempt.

craftKnownRecipeNode.description: Craft 1..3 times from one current opaque recipe query result at one visible in-reach crafting table. Copy recipe_ref and fingerprint from the same latest agent_get_state recipe result into recipe_ref and recipe_fingerprint. The runtime revalidates both before normal menu use, supports only deterministic inventory_2x2/crafting_table recipes, and stops when the component-exact absolute inventory goal is reached. station.expected_state is the exact crafting-table state shown here; its properties object is empty. Each craft places one recipe, QUICK_MOVEs exactly one result while retaining the server-proven empty cursor, then closes/reopens for authoritative full readback. Reserve at least 30000 ms, 600 ticks, 360 camera degrees, and the conservative 1+4*max_crafts interactions; distance, breaks, and placements are zero.

smeltKnownRecipeNode.description: Smelt exactly one item from one current opaque recipe query result at one visible in-reach furnace, blast furnace, or smoker. Copy recipe_ref, recipe_fingerprint, station kind, target, and complete expected_state from the same latest evidence. goal and fuel accept only default_components_only; max_smelts is fixed to 1. The declared station family, recipe display kind, required screen, exact empty menu, singleton ingredient/fuel sources, QUICK_MOVE routes, and component-exact absolute inventory goal are revalidated before input. The runtime closes/reopens after loading and after result recovery for authoritative full-content/data readback, restores the admitted view/slot, and never exposes raw slots or GUI coordinates. This node is the final top-level Action node and never appears inside if/repeat. Reserve 120000 ms, 2400 ticks, up to 540 camera degrees for aim plus view restoration, and 6 interactions; distance, breaks, and placements are zero.

standardPotionBatch.description: A component-exact unmodified Vanilla potion identity. When used as input, item+potion must match one own-inventory standard_potions entry whose aggregated count is at least this declared 1..3 count. expected_output instead declares the closed recipe result and need not already exist in inventory. Custom components are never accepted.

brewingIngredient.description: Closed 26.2 one-step table. Container conversions preserve potion: potion+gunpowder->splash_potion; splash_potion+dragon_breath->lingering_potion. Same-container potion transitions are water+glowstone_dust->thick, water+redstone->mundane, water+nether_wart->awkward. Each start mix has both water+ingredient->mundane and awkward+ingredient->effect: breeze_rod->wind_charged, slime_block->oozing, stone->infested, cobweb->weaving, magma_cream->fire_resistance, rabbit_foot->leaping, sugar->swiftness, glistering_melon_slice->healing, spider_eye->poison, ghast_tear->regeneration, blaze_powder->strength. Other transitions: awkward+golden_carrot->night_vision; night_vision+redstone->long_night_vision; night_vision+fermented_spider_eye->invisibility; long_night_vision+fermented_spider_eye->long_invisibility; invisibility+redstone->long_invisibility; fire_resistance+redstone->long_fire_resistance; leaping+redstone->long_leaping; leaping+glowstone_dust->strong_leaping; leaping+fermented_spider_eye->slowness; long_leaping+fermented_spider_eye->long_slowness; slowness+redstone->long_slowness; slowness+glowstone_dust->strong_slowness; awkward+turtle_helmet->turtle_master; turtle_master+redstone->long_turtle_master; turtle_master+glowstone_dust->strong_turtle_master; swiftness+fermented_spider_eye->slowness; long_swiftness+fermented_spider_eye->long_slowness; swiftness+redstone->long_swiftness; swiftness+glowstone_dust->strong_swiftness; awkward+pufferfish->water_breathing; water_breathing+redstone->long_water_breathing; healing+glowstone_dust->strong_healing; healing+fermented_spider_eye->harming; strong_healing+fermented_spider_eye->strong_harming; harming+glowstone_dust->strong_harming; poison+fermented_spider_eye->harming; long_poison+fermented_spider_eye->harming; strong_poison+fermented_spider_eye->strong_harming; poison+redstone->long_poison; poison+glowstone_dust->strong_poison; regeneration+redstone->long_regeneration; regeneration+glowstone_dust->strong_regeneration; strength+redstone->long_strength; strength+glowstone_dust->strong_strength; water+fermented_spider_eye->weakness; weakness+redstone->long_weakness; awkward+phantom_membrane->slow_falling; slow_falling+redstone->long_slow_falling. Any other tuple is rejected before input.

brewKnownPotionBatchNode.description: Brew exactly one catalog-fixed standard Vanilla one-step recipe for 1..3 equal-count potions at one current visible in-reach brewing stand. input must match a component-exact own-inventory standard_potions entry with sufficient aggregated singleton count. expected_output declares the component-exact closed recipe result and need not already exist in inventory; custom color/effects/name/lore, impossible overstacks, and arbitrary recipes are rejected. The declared transition is checked both against the closed 26.2 recipe table and the current connection's PotionBrewing.mix result. fuel_item is always blaze powder. All five stand item slots must be empty, internal brew-time must be zero, and the hidden Vanilla fuel counter must be within 0..20 at Action start. When it is already 1..20 the runtime consumes one existing fuel use and skips inventory fuel insertion; when it is zero the runtime inserts exactly one blaze powder. Therefore a blaze-powder ingredient needs one inventory powder when precharged and two when uncharged. These conditions are checked only after a normal menu open; no stand-slot or data value is exposed, and a mismatch returns a fixed replan diagnostic. Interrupted brewing cannot be resumed or replayed by this opcode, and every failure stops the unstarted suffix. This node is allowed only once as the final top-level Action node, never inside if/repeat and never with a following node. Planner admission and the execution-start preflight both reject a one-way stand-center |yaw|+|pitch| aim above 270 degrees before normal use. When needed, put face_known_position for the same visible stand immediately before this node and add that face node's own cost to the Action budget. Reserve at least 70000 ms, 1400 ticks, up to 540 camera degrees for this node's aim plus admitted-view restoration, and 16 interactions; distance, breaks, and placements are zero. While this terminal menu node owns the screen, recovery dispatches no gameplay interaction, so the published Action interaction ceiling remains 16. Execution uses normal use/menu clicks, fixed submitted intent, authoritative full-content/data progress and close/reopen readback that returns all five item slots empty and proves exactly one fuel use was consumed, then releases the screen/cursor/input owner before terminal publication.

collectVisibleItemNode.description: Collect at least one fresh visible minecraft:item matching displayed_item near the copied continuous target position. The runtime rechecks the witness while moving, selects the fastest reachable known safe pickup cell, and requires an absolute inventory-count increase relative to this node occurrence's start.

collectVisibleItemBatchNode.description: Collect 2..8 currently visible item witnesses in one fail-fast Action and preserve listed order. The batch fixes per-item absolute inventory baselines at batch start. A later target may complete as incidentally collected only after a fresh policy-visible item AABB actually intersects the player pickup area and the matching absolute inventory count subsequently increases; witness disappearance, movement, or merge alone never succeeds. Any failure stops the unstarted suffix.

waitUntilNode.description: At primitive start, target must be a current policy-visible wheat surface under a target-scoped fresh proof: an exact retained target mutation revision is combined with the visual barrier without being invalidated by unrelated mutation evictions; when the exact revision is absent, the global eviction floor applies fail-closed. The adopted visible_surface.eye_origin must match the current JIT observer eye within the fixed epsilon; a stale frame from a previous observer position is rejected. Authorization preserves that witness eye_origin rather than substituting the current eye, and also binds the exact world/session/dimension/target, current visual barrier, and player position. Any visual-barrier advance or observer drift beyond the epsilon terminates before BlockState is read; navigation-neutral wheat AGE updates do not advance that barrier. While the fence remains current, execution reads live BlockState only at that authorized loaded coordinate: immature wheat stays pending, mature wheat completes, and replacement, unload, or world/session change terminates fail-safe without exposing live state.

tools.name: agent_get_action
tools.title: Get MCMCP Action
tools.description: Returns bounded progress and a policy-filtered trace for one explicit action handle. wait_timeout_ms is an optional integer from 0 through 25000; zero or omission returns immediately, otherwise it waits off the Minecraft client thread until terminal or timeout.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Optional bounded terminal-state long poll. Zero or omission returns immediately; a non-terminal timeout returns the current snapshot with the unchanged output shape.

tools.name: agent_cancel_action
tools.title: Cancel MCMCP Action
tools.description: Idempotently requests cancellation of one explicit action handle.
